message.content:
This editorial illustration is the front cover of Tempo magazine. Centrally, the word "TEMPO" is written in large, white, sans-serif letters. Above it are the phrases "HITAM-PUTIH TIM SUKSES CALON PRESIDEN" and "MERANA KARENA RUPIAH". Below the title, the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears.

The main image shows a person with dark hair wearing an orange jumpsuit, sitting with head bowed and hands on knees inside a room with vertical gray bars. To the right, a gray metal sink is attached to the wall. Behind the bars, a small window reveals a blue flag with white stars and a red, white, and blue cross design. 

In the lower-right area, the word "INVESTIGASI" is set in white on a red block above the large white text "ANAK INDONESIA DI BUI AUSTRALIA." Below this, smaller white text begins with "DITUDUH MEMBAWA PENDATANG HARAM," and ends with "INVESTIGASI BERSAMA TEMPO DAN BBC NEWS INDONESIA." The lower-left corner includes the date "10-16 SEPTEMBER 2018," price "RP 45.000," and a barcode with the number "9 770126 427302."
